description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for two benchmarks or metrics, MMAU and MMAR, across three model categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” shown left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals. For each category there are two side-by-side bars: a blue bar labeled “MMAU” and a purple bar labeled “MMAR,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the MMAU (blue) bar is just under 50% (about 49%) and the MMAR (purple) bar is about 30%; for “Audio-Reasoner,” MMAU is a little above 60% (about 61%) and MMAR is in the mid-to-high 30s (about 36–37%); for “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” MMAU is mid-60s (about 65%) and MMAR is in the mid-to-high 50s (about 56–57%). The bars are grouped by model category with consistent color coding for the two metrics, the categories appear in a fixed left-to-right order (not explicitly indicated as sorted), and there are no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond the legend and standard bar coloring.
